args.root_cause: server.properties had white-list=true and enforce-whitelist=true while whitelist.json was empty ([]), so all players including regulars Alex_Builds and Steve_Mines were rejected with "You are not whitelisted".
args.actions: Checked status/logs and saw healthy TPS but players being disconnected for not being whitelisted. Read server.properties and whitelist.json (empty). Declared incident. Ran console 'whitelist off' (live fix). Edited server.properties to set white-list=false and enforce-whitelist=false so it persists. Verified Alex_Builds and Steve_Mines rejoined and TPS stayed 20. No restart, no bans, no deletions.
args.residual_risk: The server is now open to anyone, and it runs in offline mode (online-mode=false), so usernames can be spoofed. If a whitelist is wanted, populate whitelist.json with the regular players before re-enabling it. I don't know who changed the setting or why. Unknown players like newplayer07 to newplayer12 were also trying to join.
